answers.justification: The approved Result concerns time to first worsening-heart-failure event or cardiovascular death. The report gives events and randomized/analysis denominators, but not comparable numbers with outcome observation or arm-specific missing-status accounting. Figure 1 numbers at risk and ITT analysis do not establish outcome availability. A documented ascertainment account is unresolved.

Whether administrative censoring versus loss to follow-up accounts for censoring
